killedBy: developer mode: entry, indicator and exit (issue #243) shows neither the entry nor the indicator without the gate
why: Paints the DEV indicator on an ORDINARY page. The gate is issue #243's whole subject and this is the failure with the widest blast radius: every player sees a developer badge on the shipped game, and no existing test would have said so, because ~200 of them build `createHud(root)` and simply never look for developer UI. The control that catches it has to assert the ABSENCE explicitly, which is what the named test does.
